subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently own a repository-generated Microsoft ecosystem tracker and PR-body update workflow?
rationale: The patch creates a recurring maintainer process and live GitHub mutation surface; implementation fixes cannot decide whether that administrative ownership belongs in the repository.

options.title: Sponsor And Harden
options.body: Keep the tracker workflow, resolve all automation findings, add deterministic verification and real-run proof, then refresh the branch against current main.

options.title: Keep As Draft Tracker
options.body: Use this PR body as temporary working coordination without merging the generated file, script, or changelog entry.

options.title: Retire The Workflow
options.body: Close the draft if maintainers do not want to own another repository-level tracking system.

recommendation.title: Sponsor And Harden
recommendation.body: Keep the tracker workflow, resolve all automation findings, add deterministic verification and real-run proof, then refresh the branch against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans repository scripts policy, recurring maintainer operations, and release-owned file boundaries rather than only Microsoft channel implementation.
